title: Migrate synchronous context lifecycle fixtures to the owned observer and remove their obsolete ownership-wait branch
outcome: Context lifecycle fixtures exercise the same owned asynchronous preparation used by ordinary prompts, and production no longer contains the old test-only ownership-wait/retry path.
acceptance: Lifecycle fixtures that currently call cfg(test) prepare_engram_context_nudge_off_lock are migrated to owned background scheduling and deterministic transport synchronization while preserving their cache/generation/acknowledgement assertions.
The obsolete synchronous ownership-wait and retry machinery is removed without changing the explicit compact-hook exact-ticket behavior or ordinary asynchronous delivery.
